text.tspan: The server asks for structured input; the MCP client renders a native dialog from requestedSchema. The answer travels back through the MCP client.

the client: stdio, or a sessionful HTTP

The spec forbids requesting passwords, API keys or tokens in form mode. Use URL mode for secrets (see elicitation-url-mode.png).
